descriptions.job-0p0v17z:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

We are looking for an Associate, GTM Finance to help drive Ramp’s next phase of growth. This role will be a key strategic partner to cross-functional teams helping shape both (1) what our financial goals are and (2) how we will achieve them. The GTM Finance team owns key decisions around how we allocate and prioritize Ramp’s time and resources, and we are looking for a stellar Associate to quickly take on a large scope.

This is a high-impact position and represents a truly unique opportunity to join one of the country’s fastest-growing, pre-IPO startups at a time when it is critical for us to build scalable financial and operational processes, tooling, and infrastructure.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own detailed financial and operational models, ensuring the highest quality and accuracy

  • Design and implement processes & systems to support and scale one of the industry’s fastest-growing GTM organizations

  • Identify and develop KPIs; build dashboards to monitor performance and communicate insights to relevant stakeholders

  • Lead planning analyses for cross-functional teams, evaluating tradeoffs across growth, efficiency, and resourcing

  • Use data to influence and inform key strategic business, GTM, and Product decisions

  • Partner closely with operators and functional leaders to translate strategy into execution

What You Need

  • 2-4 years of experience in Strategic Finance, Operations, Investment Banking, Management Consulting, Corporate Finance, or a similar analytical role, preferably in a high-growth technology environment

  • Excellent financial modeling and quantitative / data analysis skills

  • Extreme attention to detail with a high regard for precision

  • Track record of developing and maintaining relationships with both internal and external partners

  • A “get things done” mentality; you can dissect complex problems, identify solutions, and drive these solutions to completion with a high degree of autonomy

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and adapting to evolving priorities

Nice-to-Haves

  • Expertise with Looker, SQL, and/or Python

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

descriptions.job-0h8hzu7:
Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.

Welcome to Fireblocks, the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions!

Here’s the bit about us:

Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets & cryptocurrencies. At Fireblocks, we enable businesses to securely build, run and scale digital asset operations through the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure. Our next-generation multi-layer technology protects Digital assets from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error. Fireblocks is the only platform that provides insurance for digital assets in storage, transfer, and E&O.

As of January 2025, we serve over 2000 institutional customers, have secured the transfer of over $7 trillion in digital assets, and are the world's highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised.

Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale.

Here’s the bit about the opportunity:

As part of the Fireblocks’ US Enterprise sales team, you will play a meaningful role in scaling one of the fastest-growing companies in the Blockchain and Cybersecurity field. You’ll target a mixture of Banks & Financial Institutions across the US, working closely with Sales Engineers and Business Leaders.

This position is based in our office in New York.

You’ll be:

  • Achieving monthly and quarterly revenue targets
  • Working closely with Fireblocks BDRs, Business Solutions and GTM Team
  • Building and maintaining relationships with prospects and  customers
  • Prospecting, territory, and account planning
  • Updating and maintaining the Fireblocks CRM

You’ll bring:

  • Enterprise SaaS or institutional sales experience, selling into financial services and/or TradFi
  • An understanding of how Banks operate across the enterprise
  • Passion for blockchain technology and cryptocurrency 
  • Experience within financial services, cybersecurity, or cryptocurrency is preferred
  • Experience formalizing and supporting the co-sell motion in working with technology partners is preferred
  • Track record of over-achievement in an enterprise sales position
  • Entrepreneurial and relentless hunting attitude
  • A willingness to prospect and qualify for new opportunities
  • Thrives in a team-selling environment

We have a comprehensive onboarding and training program for all new employees. We are looking for A players who want to work with the best.  Track record of success and closing complex deals within the financial services or fintech sectors.

For employees hired to work remotely from New York, or from our NYC HQ, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role.This range is specific to New York City, and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs.

It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is $140,000 to $180,750. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of you deciding to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are.

Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. 

Please see our candidate privacy policy here.

descriptions.job-09f1167:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Asset Movements Operations team at Robinhood is dedicated to offering fast, safe, and secure execution of customer requests such as wires, checks, and internal account transfers. As a critical pillar of Robinhood's brokerage business model, our team focuses on risk management and operational accuracy to support the firm's growth. We collaborate with Customer Experience, Clearing, Fraud, and Financial Crimes teams to troubleshoot complex issues and ensure seamless processing. Our culture thrives on teamwork, continuous improvement, and a shared dedication to protecting our customers' assets. Together, we are building the future of retail brokerage operations!

As an Asset Movements Operations Specialist, you will play a central role in executing daily financial transactions with precision and resolving customer requests. In this position, you will be accountable for high-priority wire, check, and journal processing while identifying operational inefficiencies. You will collaborate with project and operations teams to launch and scale Robinhood's electronic financial products. Your analytical skills will be key in mitigating money movement risks and safeguarding customer and firm assets. This is an exciting opportunity to help build our brokerage infrastructure and grow your career with us!

This role is based in our Denver, CO or Westlake, TX office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week (Wednesday, Thursday and Friday). 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Process high-priority transactions, including wires, checks, journals, and bank-linking, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
  • Evaluate and manage money movement risks from both a customer and firm perspective to mitigate financial losses.
  • Collaborate with project and operations teams to test, launch, and scale retail brokerage products and operational systems.
  • Develop and document operational processes and procedures to improve efficiency and maintain compliance standards.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in asset movements, collaborating with Customer Experience, Clearing, Fraud, and Financial Crimes teams to resolve complex customer issues.

What you bring

  • A Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience), along with 4+ years of experience in brokerage operations or financial services.
  • Active FINRA Series 7 license; an active FINRA Series 24 license is preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to identify process inefficiencies, propose concrete solutions, and manage operational risk.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex operational and compliance concepts clearly.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, deep knowledge of banking operation standards, and advanced familiarity with securities industry compliance policies.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$81,000—$95,000 USD
Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)
$71,000—$84,000 USD

$63,000—$74,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Application Limit: Candidates may submit no more than 3 applications in any 90 days. Within that time, they may apply to each role only once.

descriptions.job-02j1zu7:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

As part of the Institutional Sales team at Kalshi, you’ll source, develop and onboard institutional trading firms onto Kalshi’s perpetual futures (perps) offering. You’ll guide them through integration and go-live, then own those relationships and provide the level of service sophisticated institutional traders expect. This role suits someone who has worked in sales, trading, prime brokerage or futures, can speak fluently about leverage, margin, funding and market structure, and has trusted relationships across the institutional trading community.

What You'll Do

  • Source and develop relationships with institutional trading firms (proprietary trading firms, hedge funds, market makers, crypto-native funds and brokers) that could trade perps on Kalshi

  • Own outbound prospecting through LinkedIn, industry events and other institutional sales channels

  • Run introductory and follow-up conversations with prospective trading teams, speaking credibly about perps mechanics, including funding rates, margin and leverage, liquidation, mark pricing and clearing

  • Position Kalshi’s perps product against competing venues, including offshore and crypto-native perps exchanges, and explain the value of trading on a US-regulated platform

  • Build and manage a large pipeline of institutional relationships from initial outreach through activation

  • Guide customers through onboarding, API integration and go-live, working closely with Kalshi’s Liquidity, Product and Operations teams

  • Build deep relationships with the trading teams you bring onto the platform and provide exceptional ongoing service

  • Troubleshoot integration questions, product updates, errors and other issues for institutional customers

  • Re-engage firms that have stalled during onboarding and move them toward activation

  • Monitor customer trading activity and hold regular check-ins to understand needs, identify issues and drive deeper engagement

  • Pass market and customer feedback to the Product team to help shape the perps roadmap

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in institutional sales, trading, prime brokerage or futures (FCM, exchange or clearing) at a bank, broker, exchange, trading firm or fund

  • A strong working command of derivatives: you can discuss futures and perpetual contracts, margin, leverage, funding, collateral, risk and clearing with traders and risk managers

  • Established, trusted relationships across proprietary trading firms, hedge funds, market makers, brokers or other institutional trading organizations

  • A track record of originating and closing new institutional relationships

  • Experience guiding institutional clients through technical onboarding or API integration

  • Extremely strong professionalism and communication skills; you can credibly represent Kalshi with sophisticated institutional counterparties

  • High EQ and an ability to build trust quickly with a wide range of customers

  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing a high-volume CRM and sales pipeline

  • Based in the US and willing to work in person from our New York office

Pay Transparency Disclosure

Salary Range: $130,000 - $200,000. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we're always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.
descriptions.job-0q2x4fj:
Senior Security Researcher

Location: Tel Aviv, Israel

Chainalysis is building the data, intelligence, and technology that enable organizations to investigate and prevent crypto-related crime. Our teams combine deep blockchain expertise with advanced technology to help make the digital asset ecosystem safer and more trusted.

This team is a small, highly technical group focused on exploring emerging threats and technologies, turning insights into practical solutions, and bringing new ideas from early concepts through production.

We are looking for a talented Researcher who is excited by new and emerging technologies and can help move the organization forward by developing new capabilities, from design and proof of concept through production.

The position is office-based in Tel Aviv.


In this job, you'll:

  • Design, implement, and improve threat detection models and frameworks

  • Be an expert on bleeding-edge web3 technologies

  • Write excellent code and be an integral part of engineering efforts

  • Solve sophisticated technical problems and "make hard things work"

  • Work in a small, agile, fast-moving team that is best in class


We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Proven experience in research in highly technical environments / low level R&D

  • Ability to excel in a dynamic environment with rapidly changing requirements

  • Previous experience in software development or R&D style teams


Nice to have experience:

  • Blockchain prior experience / interest

  • Experience with Python, Go, or Rust

  • Experience with classic data science / machine learning

  • Experience with building agentic LLM-powered products


Technologies we use:

  • Python

  • Go

  • Rust

  • Agentic workflows

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.
descriptions.job-01y4wfj:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the Public Sector market for Ardence, TRM’s AI-native investigation platform. Product marketing at TRM is organized as product PMM and market PMM. Product PMM owns platform positioning, differentiation, and launches across markets. Market PMM turns that foundation into growth within one market: understanding the buyers, running the sales and customer programs, and driving adoption and expansion. This is a market PMM role. You work closely with a Product Manager, Sales, and Customer Success. The PM builds, Sales opens doors, and you make sure buyers and existing customers know what Ardence can do for their missions and use it. AI handles the execution. You handle the judgment.

This role supports Defense and National Security customers as well as the rest of Public Sector. It requires U.S. citizenship and residence in the United States.

What you’ll own

You’ll own the Public Sector market position and growth programs for Ardence. Your buyers and users are investigators and analysts running complex, high-stakes cases for government agencies. Most Public Sector growth comes from existing customers, so a large part of the job is helping them use more of Ardence and expand into additional teams, workflows, and missions.

  • Public Sector positioning, messaging, demos, and sales materials built on the shared Ardence story

  • Defense and National Security positioning and programs, built with the teams that serve those agencies

  • Adoption and expansion programs for existing customers: which teams and missions could use more of TRM, what they would need to buy, and the stories, demos, and customer proof Sales and CS need to have that conversation

  • Customer marketing for Public Sector: finding customers who have capabilities they aren’t using, reaching the right users, and measuring whether usage changes

  • Mission-specific research and campaign content that supports both existing customer growth and new business

  • Follow-through on every launch in your market: did it reach the intended buyers, start qualified conversations, and get existing customers using what shipped

How you’ll work

Deep diving: You know the product at the level where you can demo it as well as anyone in the company. You know where the real value sits and where it breaks down. You’re in deal reviews and customer conversations often enough to know what lands, and you can hold a real conversation with both engineering and buyers.

Positioning: You take the shared Ardence story and make it specific to how government investigations run. You find the framing where a Public Sector buyer sees why TRM fits their mission, and you get claims agreed with Product at the start of a launch, not the night before.

Incepting: The story only works if the company carries it. You get Sales and CS telling it without you in the room, and you feed what you hear from agencies back to the product PMM and Product so the story and the roadmap improve.

Owning the moment: A launch, an enablement session, the materials a seller brings to an agency meeting. These are the moments where TRM either makes an impression or misses one. You own the narrative, the timing, and the outcome.

What we’re looking for

Storytelling. You think in narrative, not slides. You can make something technical matter to an agency buyer in two sentences, and your stories rest on customer signals, usage data, and win/loss patterns. You carry the same story across a one-pager, a demo, and an enablement session.

Commercial instincts. You understand what moves a deal and what moves an expansion, not just what sounds good in a deck. You’ve been in enough sales cycles to know the difference, and you’ve changed your positioning because of it.

AI builder. You build systems for the team, not just yourself. You’ve already offloaded repeatable work to automation, such as competitive monitoring, content generation, and usage reporting. Walk us through something you built that made the whole team faster.

Judgment. You know what good looks like and say so when it isn’t: a deck sellers aren’t using, a claim Product hasn’t confirmed, a launch that shipped without follow-through. You give feedback that moves things forward.

Customer-led measurement. You decide how to measure adoption and expansion, and you change the program when the numbers say it isn’t working.

Hard requirements

  • U.S.-only citizenship and residence in the United States

  • 5+ years in product marketing at a B2B SaaS company

  • You’ve owned at least two tier-one launches end to end: strategy, narrative, execution, and post-launch measurement

  • You’ve owned a website or major digital channel and made content decisions that moved pipeline, not just pageviews

  • You already use AI to build workflows and systems and can walk through a real example of something you built for your team, not just yourself

Deal breakers

  • Marketers who measure output in assets shipped

  • Anyone who treats AI as something to explore rather than something already running in their workflow

  • Candidates whose best examples inherited existing infrastructure. We need builders, not operators of programs someone else built.

About the team

TRM’s product team doesn’t coordinate work. It owns outcomes. Product marketers are embedded in the sales motion, in customer conversations, and in launch decisions. The team is small, the scope is real, and what you ship shows up directly in how deals close and how customers use TRM. PMMs here don’t wait to be asked. If the standard is slipping somewhere, you say so and help. AI is how we work, not just what we build.

If you do this well, existing Public Sector customers use more of Ardence, expansion conversations start from a story Sales and CS already carry, and TRM’s Public Sector market grows through the customers we already have.

What TRM speed looks like in this role

  • Sales asks for enablement on a new Public Sector program. You write the qualifying criteria and talk track, build a one-pager and slides, and run the enablement session that week.

  • A new capability ships. Within days you turn it into Public Sector messaging, a short demo, and a one-pager that Sales and CS can use with existing customers.

  • Usage data shows a customer is underusing Ardence. You turn it into an expansion story with the right demo and proof, and get it to the account team before their next conversation with the economic buyer.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $195,000.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Our R&D team is distributed not distant and will participate in work weeks, typically 1–2 times per quarter, at a TRM hub or other designated location. Work weeks may be scheduled with as little as 14 days’ notice, and some roles may require additional travel based on team and cross-functional needs. TRM coordinates and covers approved travel, lodging, and workspace.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.
descriptions.job-05v8pnz:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next- generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hut 8 is hiring a Finance partner to own the accounting for our data center development projects, from commitment and budget through cost capture, capitalization, and close. You will be the single point of accountability for what each project costs and how it is recorded: costs coded to the right budget line, capitalized correctly, and reconciled from the project ledger to the general ledger.

Project payables sit inside the role, so the person who accounts for the cost also controls how invoices are matched, approved, and paid. You will lead a team of project accountants, one per site, and work daily with Construction, Supply Chain, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, and Accounting.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Project Accounting

  • Own the WBS and cost-code structure for each project, and make sure every cost is coded to an approved budget line item.
  • Track committed, incurred, accrued, and paid cost against budget, contract value, and forecast for each project, and flag overruns early.
  • Incorporate change orders into commitments and budgets to ensure proper tracking.
  • Help prepare monthly project cost reports (budget vs. actual vs. forecast) and cost-to-complete forecasts with FP&A and project leadership.
  • Determine capitalization treatment (capitalize vs. expense) for project costs, and maintain CIP roll-forwards by project, including capitalized interest where applicable.
  • Support transfers from CIP to fixed assets when projects are placed in service, in coordination with Accounting.
  • Prepare month-end accruals for work performed but not yet invoiced, using percent complete, site progress, and retainage from Construction and Supply Chain.
  • Reconcile project cost ledgers and CIP to the general ledger, and keep the support for capitalized costs (contracts, POs, invoices, approvals) ready for quarterly reviews and audits.
  • Ensure adherence to SOX controls for each project.

Project Payables

  • Run commitment-based AP: match invoices to POs, subcontracts, and change orders while monitoring committed balances.
  • Own invoice-to-pay across multiple sites and legal entities, including urgent and off-cycle payments, and track retainage and lien waivers for construction vendors.
  • Complete AP subledger-to-GL and vendor statement reconciliations and aging reviews.
  • Onboard vendors, open bank accounts, and set up new legal entities with Treasury, Accounting, and Legal.

Team and Controls

  • Lead, coach, and prioritize the project accountants (one per site) through month-end close and high-volume payment cycles.
  • Design scalable processes and controls over project cost and payables (budget approval before commitment, PO matching, segregation of duties) in NetSuite and Ramp.
  • Report on project spend, accruals, and AP aging to leadership.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in project accounting, construction accounting, or accounting operations, including 5+ years leading a team.
  • Deep project cost accounting experience: WBS and cost coding, budget vs. actual reporting, cost-to-complete forecasting, and change orders.
  • Hands-on experience with capitalized costs and CIP, including capitalization policy and roll-forwards.
  • Experience with PO-driven, commitment-based AP (POs, subcontracts, change orders, retainage) across multiple legal entities and bank accounts.
  • Working knowledge of internal controls over procure-to-pay and capitalization.
  • Fluency in NetSuite and Ramp, and advanced Excel skills.
  • Clear communicator who can explain accounting requirements to non-finance teams such as Construction and Supply Chain.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA license.
  • Data center, energy, or infrastructure industry background.
  • Public company or SOX experience.

About Hut 8

Hut 8 builds and operates large-scale data centers for AI, colocation, cloud, and Bitcoin mining workloads.

Technologies we use:

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

About Figure

We’re Figure (Nasdaq: FIGR), and we’re building the future of capital markets with blockchain and AI. We make lending faster and cheaper for everyone by automating the origination process and using blockchain as the source of truth for loan ownership and connection to our capital marketplace.

It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business:

  • Lending: HELOCs, cash-out refinance, DSCR loans, and crypto-backed loans for homeowners, investors, and small businesses. Through Kiavi, a Figure company, we also finance real estate investors with bridge, fix-and-flip, rental, and new construction loans.
  • Markets: On Figure Markets, people can lend and earn with Prime and $YLDS, an SEC-registered, interest-bearing security that settles like cash. OPEN is our blockchain infrastructure for issuing, distributing, and trading equities.
  • Partnerships: Banks, credit unions, fintechs, home improvement companies, and other lenders and brokers originate loans on our platform. DART records loan ownership on blockchain, and Figure Connect connects originators with institutional loan buyers.

See all of our products on figure.com.

Here’s where we are today:

  • $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform
  • 382K+ households served
  • 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs
  • AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s
  • $23B+ funded for real estate investors through Kiavi since 2013
  • Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000)

If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Manager, Capital Markets to join our growing team! As Manager within the Capital Markets team, you’ll own day-to-day execution of our secondary transactions, including whole loan trades, liquidity, and warehouse sales and repurchases, while supporting securitizations and investor initiatives. You’ll help scale the settlement, pipeline, and reporting processes behind Figure’s growing origination volume and product suite. The role calls for a strong working knowledge of internal guidelines and external agreements, and close collaboration with Capital Markets, Finance, mortgage operations, origination, and servicing teams, as well as external counterparties.

What You’ll Do

  • Build short- and long-term RTL and DSCR trade plans with pricing and origination teams, aligning takeout and capacity with projected fundings, liquidity needs, allocations, and counterparty terms
  • Manage warehouse facilities day-to-day, including line activity, sales, and repurchases, and track eligibility criteria, concentration limits, advance rates, loan aging, and margin calls
  • Support the Director on warehouse facility renewals and amendments
  • Analyze execution across buyers by comparing bids and reviewing post-trade P&L, and recommend where loans should be allocated based on price, speed, and terms
  • Monitor the funded and in-process pipeline against takeout commitments, and work with risk and origination teams to find the best takeout for each loan across potential buyers
  • Lead trade strategy and loan allocations, optimizing warehouse facility usage and trade channels for best execution
  • Lead the team executing transactions, from investor onboarding and loan pool diligence through resolution of collateral and credit exceptions, settlement, and transaction confirms, and review the team’s work for accuracy and timeliness
  • Serve as the escalation point for diligence findings and exceptions with investors, due diligence vendors, and internal credit teams
  • Build a strong working knowledge of sale and financing contracts, including MLPAs and warehouse agreements, to guide the team’s execution
  • Produce accurate loan tapes for investors, warehouse lenders, and trustees, making sure loan-level data is complete and reconciled before delivery
  • Deliver accurate portfolio and pipeline reporting to support ongoing liquidity, capacity, and capital planning
  • Own monthly reporting requirements under warehouse, trade, and securitization agreements, including counterparty and trustee reporting
  • Reconcile data across internal systems, servicers, and counterparties, and resolve discrepancies at the source
  • Partner with Technology and Product to improve capital markets data and reporting tools and automate manual processes

What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in finance, accounting, economics, or real estate
  • 4+ years of relevant experience in capital markets, structured finance, corporate finance, or mortgage banking
  • Experience with whole loan trades, warehouse lines, or securitizations (strongly preferred)
  • Mortgage or real estate industry experience (preferred, not required)
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with excellent written and verbal communication
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team; experience mentoring or leading junior team members is a plus
  • A get-things-done mentality: a self-starter who identifies, overcomes, and works around obstacles to get to the finish line
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; SQL and Tableau experience (preferred)
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.

  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

descriptions.job-15r3ynj:
TAX OPERATIONS

The Global Tax team’s mission is to support the firm’s compliance with the tax laws and associated reporting obligations of the countries and local jurisdictions in which the firm conducts business. Global Tax analyzes and supports the activities, operations, reporting obligations and transactions of the firm’s business lines so that tax consequences and reputational risks are evaluated appropriately.

OPERATIONS

Operations is a dynamic, multi-faceted function that partners with all areas of the firm to deliver banking, sales and trading, and asset management capabilities to clients around the world. Alongside this service-delivery role, Operations provides essential risk management and control, preserving and enhancing the firm’s assets and reputation. Operations develops the processes and controls and helps specify the systems that deliver accuracy, timeliness and integrity across the business.

YOUR IMPACT

We are seeking an Analyst to join the Tax Operations team to support the firm’s tax reporting obligations, digital transformation, and control governance. In this role, you will develop a deep understanding of core tax systems and processes, applying quantitative rigor and an inquisitive mindset to identify control gaps, remediate processing breaks, and drive sustainable operational improvements. The candidate will be part of the "Change the Bank" initiatives by leveraging BI platforms and AI tools to automate workflows and enhance reporting efficiency. You will collaborate with global teams on critical regulatory tax reform implementations such as FATCA and CRS - while continuously monitoring the regulatory landscape and acting as a regional operational point of contact. Throughout these initiatives, you will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Controllers, and Business Stakeholders to strengthen the internal control environment, retain critical specialist knowledge, and ensure strict compliance with global tax authorities.

OUR IMPACT

Tax Operations supports the activities, operations, reporting obligations and transactions of the firm’s business lines so that tax consequences and reputational risks are evaluated appropriately. The team manages end-to-end information reporting and withholding governance as well as U.S. and CRS documentation validation, reporting, and Swiss withholding tax reconciliations - while fielding cross-border client tax inquiries. Furthermore, the team evaluates regulatory and business changes to design robust internal controls, partnering closely with Engineering to automate workflows and scale strategic platforms.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • U.S. Information Reporting & QI Compliance: End-to-end reconciliation, withholding tax accounting, and electronic submission of IRS Forms 1042, 1042-S, 1099, and Schedule K-1 packages, ensuring strict Qualified Intermediary (QI) compliance and ledger-to-deposit alignment.
  • Global CRS & U.S. Documentation: Multi-jurisdictional FATCA and CRS reporting programs - overseeing account scoping, XML schema validation, and regulatory filings - while leading annual W-8/W-9/CRS solicitation campaigns to remediate documentation defects, including CRS and U.S. Tax Form validation.

  • Risk Governance & Strategic Transformation: Served as the regional tax operations SME and risk controller, driving control remediation, leading regulatory change initiatives (FATCA/CRS), and optimizing operational tax workflows across global teams.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree required, along with 1–3 years of relevant industry experience in financial services, operations, or accounting.
  • Analytical & Control Mindset: Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities, supported by a strong risk-and-control mentality and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and standard office productivity suites.
  • Understanding of financial-services operations, transaction lifecycles and upstream data or booking dependencies; ability to learn relevant tax rules and apply them operationally.
  • Communication & Relationship Management: Aptitude for building collaborative relationships and communicating complex technical and operational topics clearly across diverse internal stakeholders.
  • Workload & Priority Management: Self-motivated, proactive team player with a strong sense of ownership and accountability; demonstrated capability to organize and manage multiple competing, time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Resilience & Collaboration: Flexible, adaptable, and able to perform under pressure within a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex tax, data and control matters clearly.

ABOUT GOLDMAN SACHS

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We are committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual has opportunities to grow professionally and personally, including through training and development, firmwide networks, benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings, and mindfulness programmes. Learn more about our culture, benefits and people at GS.com/careers.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Further information is available through the Goldman Sachs careers website.

About Prime Intellect

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators, including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

You’ll build the organization behind that mission. Working directly with the founders, you’ll shape how we develop exceptional people, reward their contributions, and grow teams that can do work few companies have attempted.

This is a chance to build the People function from the ground up as our headcount and business scale rapidly. You’ll set direction and stay close to the work, from a consequential compensation decision to closing a great hire.

To start, hands-on and strategic Talent Acquisition will be a key focus, focused on G&A, growth, and marketing roles, alongside our internal talent team and helping scale that team.

This role is based onsite in our San Francisco office.

What You Will Do

  • Shape our approach to performance, development, and reviews, helping ambitious people do their best work and grow with Prime.

  • Partner with the founders, finance, and talent on compensation, equity, leveling, and progression as the company scales.

  • Help leaders build their teams, develop managers, and think ahead about organization design and retention.

  • Personally source and close G&A, growth, and marketing hires, working alongside our internal talent team and helping scale it. Build relationships with investors and recruiting partners who can bring exceptional people into Prime.

  • Lead and scale People Ops as we bring on our first People Operations Coordinator and build out our partnership on onboarding, employee experience, and day-to-day operations.

  • Be a trusted partner to employees and leaders, bringing warmth, discretion, and clear judgment to important conversations.

Requirements

  • You’ve built People teams and organizational foundations from scratch at a startup, then helped them scale through rapid growth. You can point to what you personally built and how it held up.

  • You’ve shaped performance and compensation approaches that people understand and leaders actually use.

  • You’ve personally sourced and closed strong G&A, growth, or marketing hires, and enjoy staying involved in recruiting.

  • You’re comfortable working directly with founders, making thoughtful calls with incomplete information, and turning decisions into action.

  • You are deeply excited by our mission: to build open superintelligence and the stack for everyone to build and use it.

Benefits and Perks

  • $250-300k+ cash compensation + meaningful equity

  • Full medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and dependents.

  • Flexible PTO.

  • $200/month health and wellness benefit.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support

  • Professional development budget for courses and conferences.

  • Team off-sites and conference attendance.

  • Company-covered meals when working from our San Francisco office.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Coinbase Corporate Security (CorpSec) is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to build and maintain security controls that protect corporate infrastructure, user devices, enterprise applications, and network communications. You'll partner closely with IT and engineering teams to identify risks and ship tailored solutions that keep users secure without introducing unnecessary friction, directly protecting Coinbase's most sensitive data and critical assets.

What you'll do:

  • Design, implement, and maintain security solutions to harden Coinbase's macOS, Chromebook, and mobile endpoints, focusing on secure configurations, compliance, threat detection, and user experience.
  • Perform security reviews on enterprise systems and software that enable user productivity across the corporate environment.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate endpoint and SaaS security into broader corporate engineering initiatives.
  • Identify and close data exfiltration paths introduced by local AI agents and developer tooling (e.g., coding assistants, LLM harnesses) running on corporate endpoints.
  • Provide technical guidance and code review support to engineers on the CorpSec team, raising the security bar across the organization.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, with at least 2 years securing macOS or similar user endpoints in an enterprise environment.
  • Proven ability to write production code (services, integrations, automations) that supports corporate infrastructure security.
  • Experience scoping, prioritizing, and shipping security projects end-to-end with minimal direction in fast-moving environments.
  • Familiarity with device trust, zero trust network access, or endpoint communication security products (e.g., Cloudflare, Prisma Access, Zscaler).
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
